strata_specifics.ground_texture: Smooth silty clay and pale ochre coastal flats with soft, clean dust geometry

layer_3_action.subject: Carnotaurus
features: short deep snub-nosed skull with thick bull-like brow horns
crimson-red highlights on the horn tips
long athletic hind legs built for sprinting
tiny vestigial four-fingered arms tucked flush against the body
large calm intelligent yellow eyes with a focused expression
smooth matte burnt-umber clay skin with clean sculpted charcoal-grey osteoderm bumps
layer_3_action.action: A composed, non-aggressive Carnotaurus with high-poly clay geometry is captured mid-stride in a graceful, balanced sprint across a pale ochre coastal flat. The camera frames a clean side profile to dramatically accentuate its unique snub-nosed head shape, prominent bull horns, and athletic, leggy silhouette without any scary or predatory expressions. The background features a simplified, stylized Cretaceous lagoon with sparse, salt-tolerant clay vegetation under soft, balanced studio lighting. No text.
